scope: Dev13 scoring protocol; eligible for later Test40 use only after candidate-blind Test40 reference construction and freeze

primary_metric.name: mean_component_balanced_core_reference_claim_coverage
primary_metric.within_component: mean over core required-content claim groups
primary_metric.within_question: equal mean over frozen task components
primary_metric.comparison: paired system difference with question-clustered percentile bootstrap

required_reporting: reverse-order paired difference and confidence interval
mean and maximum absolute score differences
constraint, boundary, and error-flag disagreement counts

binary_evaluation.reason: The project elected not to collect blinded human adequacy labels. A binary threshold would therefore be uncalibrated and is removed rather than selected from the same machine scores it would classify.

outside_gold_policy: Additional content is neutral unless it contradicts a frozen claim, violates a frozen material boundary, or contains a demonstrable reference-anchored material error.

development_boundary.change_effect: Removal of the unexecuted human-label and binary-threshold plan; no change to reference, prompt, claim status scale, continuous aggregation, or observed scores

dev13_results.reuse_status: continuous outputs inherited byte-for-byte and hash-locked; no API rerun
